sections.title: Shared icon grid checks
sections.what: Renders all sport and UI icons and checks each for grid size, hidden flag, fixed colour codes, and a matching name attribute.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps every icon on one shared grid so they line up across the app.
sections.watch_out: The sport names are typed into the test, so a new sport icon is not checked unless someone adds it.

summary: Checks that every sport and UI icon uses the same 48-unit grid, is hidden from screen readers, and takes its colour from the surrounding text.
purpose: Keeps the icons looking consistent and theme-aware, and keeps decorative icons out of screen reader output.
why: Likely reason: icons that use fixed colours would look wrong in dark mode, and icons that are read aloud would add noise for blind users.
how: 1) Renders each sport icon and each UI icon to plain markup. 2) Checks each one for the grid size, the hidden-from-screen-reader flag, and the absence of fixed colour codes. 3) Checks that each UI icon carries its name in a data attribute.
inputs: The Pictogram and UiPictogram components, the list of five sport names written in the file, and the six UI icon names.
outputs: Pass or fail for the grid, the decorative flag, the colour rule and the name attribute.
risks: A new icon is only checked if its name is added to the local list, so a new icon can skip the checks without warning.
debug: If the colour check fails, look at the icon markup for a hex code or an rgb value. If a name check fails, confirm the name in the list matches the component.
